textsNote: Texts sent a month, averaged over the 3 months to 11 Nov 2026.

ageNote: Days from the account being created in the app to 11 Nov 2026, not the subscription start.
industryNote: Industry as classified in the export, from the company name and the texts the account sends.
cleaningNote: Cleaning business, from the export's Industry: Carpet & Upholstery, Window & Exterior, House & Commercial, Duct & Dryer Vent Cleaning, and Restoration.
